mentions.name: getapps.cafe
mentions.description: A Setapp alternative offering a growing collection of 40 local-first, self-contained apps, with a focus on local, privacy-by-default software. The apps are built with the help of Claude Code while the developer reads and reviews the code.
mentions.source_excerpt: I created a setapp alternative at https://getapps.cafe. 40 local-first apps and counting and yes I use claude code to help building all these apps (and I do read the code).
